name: Folangsi Co., Ltd.
summary: Folangsi Co., Ltd., provides intralogistics equipment solutions in China and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Intralogistics Equipment Subscription Services; Maintenance and Repair Services; and Sales of Intralogistics Equipment and Parts. Its intralogistics equipment includes counterbalanced, reach, and warehouse forklifts.
